verdict.rationale: The docs mention SSO and role-based access controls at the org/project level (llamaparse-docs-9, llamaparse-docs-18), but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege API key/credential issuance for agents (e.g., per-tool or per-scope API keys). Missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege API key creation, granular permission scoping per credential, any documented mechanism to restrict an agent's API key to a subset of actions/data.
